email.title: Gecko Account Email
email.description: Your Gecko spa account email address

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token (Advanced)
refreshToken.description: If email/password login fails, obtain a refresh token via the Gecko OAuth flow and paste it here. Leave blank to use email/password.

pollInterval.title: Token Keep-Alive Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh the API token in the background. State updates come via MQTT push, so this only keeps the API token fresh.

maxTempOverrideC.title: Max Target Temperature Override (°C)
maxTempOverrideC.description: Override the spa configuration's max target temperature. Set to 41 to allow up to 106°F. The spa firmware still enforces its own ceiling.

minTempOverrideC.title: Min Target Temperature Override (°C)
minTempOverrideC.description: Override the spa configuration's min target temperature.

pumps.title: Pump Speed Configuration
pumps.description: Override auto-detected pump speeds. The plugin reads zones.flow.X.speed from the spa configuration automatically — only fill this in if auto-detection gets it wrong.

speeds.title: Number of Speeds
speeds.description: 1 = on/off switch in HomeKit. 2+ = fan with that many discrete speed steps.
